name: Manticore

actions.name: Tail Spikes
actions.effect: Ranged attack at long range. The Manticore flings 1d4 tail spikes. Can use Tail Spikes up to 4 times per encounter before running out.

reactions.name: Aerial Evasion
reactions.effect: When targeted by a ranged attack while flying, +3 to all defenses against that attack.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Can fly. Does not provoke reactions when flying out of reach.

traits.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
traits.desc: The Manticore regrows spent tail spikes at the rate of 1 per day.

lore: Manticores are savage predators with the body of a lion, wings of a dragon, and a tail bristling with deadly spikes. They are cruel and cunning, preferring to pepper prey with tail spikes from the air before swooping in for the kill.
